units: Gitt. 19ᵃ (expl. סיקרא) ס׳ שמה its name is s’ḳarta.—Esp. marking with siḳra.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 58a:13">Bekh. 58ᵃ</cite> <he>אי אפשר … משום ס׳</he> you cannot tithe sheep on the Holy Day on account of the required marking with paint; <cite ref="Chagigah 8a:7">Ḥag. 8ᵃ</cite>.

<cite ref="Nazir 39a:6">Naz. 39ᵃ</cite> <he>תא שמע מס׳ וכ׳</he> come, learn it (that the hair grows from the root) from the mark on sheep, where you can see that the wool beneath is loose (while that on top is matted).
